title: Retry charges on 429
body:
Checkout failed outright whenever the provider answered 429.

The provider rate limits bursts, not sustained load, so a short wait almost always succeeds. We chose exponential backoff rather than a fixed delay because a fixed delay re-synchronises all the retrying checkouts into another burst.

title: Include tax in cart totals
body: The cart showed net prices while the provider charged gross, which caused support tickets about being overcharged. `total` now takes a tax rate so that the cart and the charge agree.
